lead: Four hotels facing the most iconic architectural work in Valencia: the Oceanogràfic, the Palau de les Arts and the Museu de les Ciències at your door.

The hotels in the City of Arts and Sciences area cover every profile: from the design hotel with a premium spa and private garden to the pair of hotels built into a shopping centre with direct access to the Oceanogràfic, by way of a classic tower facing the Turia and the property with the best direct views of the Calatrava skyline.
Bus line 19, with a stop in front of all the hotels, connects in 10 minutes with the historic centre and the Malvarrosa Beach. The area has plenty of parking and connections by metro, bus and tram.

items.title: Eurostars Rey Don Jaime
items.subtitle: Rooftop pool · Facing the Palau de la Música · 319 rooms · 10 event rooms
items.body: The Eurostars Rey Don Jaime is one of the great benchmark hotels next to the City of Arts and Sciences. Its imposing 14-storey tower rises opposite the Turia Gardens and the Palau de la Música of Valencia, less than 1 km from the Calatrava complex. With 319 spacious, contemporary rooms — some with bathrobe and slippers on the upper floors —, an outdoor rooftop pool with solarium and sun loungers, a gym and a restaurant with local produce, it offers a complete experience. The buffet breakfast is highly rated, with vegetarian, lactose-free and gluten-free options. Bus line 19 has a stop on the corner of the hotel and connects with the centre and the beach. It has 10 rooms for events, congresses and conventions with capacity for up to 250 people.

items.title: Primus Valencia
items.subtitle: 800 m² spa · Outdoor pool · 2,000 m² private garden · Design by Patricia Urquiola · 600 m from the CAC
items.body: The Primus Valencia is the most exclusive hotel in the City of Arts and Sciences area, with the category of superior 4 stars. Located just 600 metres from the complex, between the Paseo de la Alameda and the Avenida de Francia, it stands out for its cutting-edge design with elements by the architects Patricia Urquiola, Francesc Rifé and Jean Marie Massaud. Its 262 rooms — all exterior, bright and soundproofed — include parquet floors, minibar, laptop-size safe and an extra-large bed. The presidential suite and the Primus executive floor raise the offer to a premium level. The 800 m² spa is one of the most complete in Valencia: dynamic pool, polar pool, jacuzzi, sauna, hammam, essence showers and treatment rooms. The 2,000 m² private garden with outdoor pool and a 200 m² terrace complete a hotel that is, in itself, a destination.

items.title: ILUNION Aqua 3 · ILUNION Aqua 4
items.subtitle: 300 m from the Oceanogràfic · Accessible and pet friendly · Shared restaurant · Parking · Spa and cinemas in the same building
items.body: The ILUNION Aqua 3 and Aqua 4 hotels are a unique proposition in Valencia: two sister properties — of 3 and 4 stars respectively — built into the Aqua Multiespacio shopping centre, only 300 metres from the Oceanogràfic and the City of Arts and Sciences. The Aqua 3 offers 135 modern, functional standard double rooms, while the Aqua 4 has 163 double rooms with views of the Oceanogràfic, 8 suites of 40 m² and triple family rooms, and is especially recommended for families (children under 8 stay free). Both share a restaurant — the Aqua 3 with a market menu; the Aqua 4 with the innovative Umániko gastronomic concept — and direct access to the spa, gym, multiplex cinema and shops of the shopping centre. The whole ILUNION chain stands out for its universal accessibility and its pet-friendly policy.

items.title: Barceló Valencia
items.subtitle: Facing the Palau de les Arts · Terrace with pool on the 10th floor · Calatrava views · Senyoret restaurant
items.body: The Barceló Valencia is the hotel with the most spectacular location in the area: situated directly opposite the Palau de les Arts Reina Sofía, the masterpiece of Santiago Calatrava, it offers unique views of the skyline of the City of Arts and Sciences. Its 187 spacious, bright rooms — including 10 junior suites and 2 suites — are equipped with 2×2 metre King Size beds, LCD TV, minibar, safe and free WiFi. The tenth-floor terrace, with a pool and solarium and panoramic views of the Calatrava complex, is one of the most photographed spots in Valencia. The à la carte restaurant Senyoret serves Mediterranean market cuisine, while the Lobby Bar El Gotet offers snacks and cocktails with views of the city. Bus line 19 stops at the door: it reaches the centre and the beach in 10 minutes.

blocks.title: Tips for staying in the City of Arts and Sciences
items: For the best views of the CAC: ask for a room with a view at the Barceló Valencia — the view of the Palau de les Arts from the room is spectacular
The Primus Valencia has the best spa in the area (800 m²): €18/person, much cheaper if you are a hotel guest
The ILUNION Aqua 3 and 4 are ideal for families with children — direct access to the Oceanogràfic and children under 8 stay free at the Aqua 4
Bus L19 stops right at the door of the hotels and takes you to the historic centre and the beach in 10 minutes
The Turia Gardens are reachable on foot from all the hotels: by bike you reach the historic centre in 20 minutes along a beautiful bike lane
Book in advance in summer and Holy Week: the area fills up because of the Oceanogràfic and the events at the Palau de les Arts
